title: npm run verify is flaky: R18 render p95 8.6-8.7 ms > 8 budget; unit failed once
where: projects/tower-defense: npm run verify (perf step, unit step)
detail: Steps: 1. cd projects/tower-defense; npm ci && npm run build. 2. Run npm run verify three times on a clean box. Expected: green each time. Actual: run 1 FAIL unit + FAIL perf (R18 render frame p95 8.60 ms > 8), run 2 GREEN, run 3 FAIL perf (p95 8.70 ms > 8). Unit passed on isolated rerun (163/163), so the unit failure is load-sensitive. Ship gate (--strict) is unreliable; budget has no headroom. Evidence: verify output, evidence-local/perf/perf.json.

title: R18 render perf gate fails 3 of 4 runs (p95 7.3-9.2 ms vs 8 ms budget); verify is red, the 6.2 ms claim does not reproduce
detail: Repro: cd projects/tower-defense && npm run verify -> 'FAIL R18 render frame p95 8.40 ms > 8', VERIFY FAILED (1). Then node scripts/e2e/perf.mjs x3 -> 9.20 / 7.30 / 8.70 ms. Split per frame (scratch probe, same stage): game JS mean 2.3 ms, p95 5.0; the 1-px readback (raster flush) mean 5.6, p95 8.6. CPU profile: getImageData 70%, drawImage 8.6%. Measured costs at 1280x720: full-canvas alpha blit 0.48 ms, full fillRect 0.26 ms. So each frame pays paper fill + ground cache blit + grain blit, about 1.2 ms, before any blot. Expected: verify green with margin on the review box. Fix: (1) bake the paper into an opaque ground cache and drop drawPaper on play/title frames (one opaque copy instead of fill + blend); (2) cut per-blot blits (shadow and body are 2 drawImage calls per blot, plus filtered scaled blits during squash); (3) re-measure as the median of 3 perf runs and record the spread in the WO-004 report. Do not raise the budget.

title: Hit-stop freeze shimmers: blots/projectiles keep ps != s, so render interpolation slides them during the frozen ticks
detail: step() returns early while hitStop > 0, before move() sets b.ps = b.s (also p.px/py in stepDart/stepStone, t.pangle in updateTowers). Renderers draw ps + (s - ps)*alpha, so whenever alpha changes between frames (any refresh rate other than 60 Hz, or rAF jitter) every blot slides by up to one tick of travel and then snaps back each tick for the whole freeze. Repro (scratch vitest): spawn a blotch, step twice, set state.hitStop = 12, step -> s = 106.13, ps = 103.07 (3.07 px gap). §11 says hit-stop is a freeze; boss death is 12 ticks (200 ms). Fix: in the hit-stop branch set ps = s for live blots, px/py = x/y for projectiles and pangle = angle for towers (or render with alpha = 1 while state.hitStop > 0). Add a unit test asserting s === ps during hit-stop.

title: Holding Backspace sells the selected tower: key-repeat passes the two-press confirm
detail: The keydown handler drops auto-repeats for every key except Backspace. sell(false) arms on the first press and sells on any second call within 1 s, so holding Backspace past the OS repeat delay (250-600 ms) sells the tower with one press. §13: 'Backspace/Delete sell (two presses within 1 s)'. No test covers repeat:true (tests/unit/ui/game.test.ts:67 always sends repeat:false). Fix: ignore repeats for Backspace too (remove the exception) and add a unit test where a repeat:true keydown does not sell.

title: Vignette and grain overlays allocate 2 extra full-backing-store canvases (about 63 MB at 3840x2160) and rebuild them on every resize
detail: ensureOverlays makes vignetteCv and grainCv at cv.width x cv.height. Measured at 1920x1080 viewport, DPR 2: three 3840x2160 offscreen canvases exist (ground cache + vignette + grain), 31.6 MB each. Only the two vignette edge bands (about 43% of the width) are ever blitted. Each resize event (window drag) re-creates both canvases, paints them and clears the blot sprite cache, all inside one frame. Fix: store only the two vignette bands (x0 and w - x1 wide). For the grain, keep a device-resolution tile and fill it as a source-over pattern at an integer offset; benchmark it against the current 0.48 ms full blit before switching. Optionally debounce resize rebuilds.

title: Blot sprite cache duplicates Shadow/Flash sprites per colourblind (and Flash per Pale) flag; Sprite.half is dead
detail: paintShadow ignores cb, and the Flash layer ignores both cb and pale, but both flags are in the key. Measured at DPR 2 fullscreen R18: 411 sprites (16.1 MB), rising to 579 (22.1 MB) after the colourblind toggle. Sprite.half (line 276/305) is never read. Fix: normalise cb = false for Layer.Shadow, and cb = pale = false for Layer.Flash, before building the key. Drop the half field.

title: Live blot path ignores the pass globalAlpha while sprites honour it
detail: The sprite blit uses outerAlpha (set by game.ts passes()), but paintShadow/paintBody overwrite globalAlpha with o.alpha * ..., where paint.alpha is always 1. So when a pass fades (title->play transition, title fade-in), Knot and Inkmaw (always live) and the no-canvas fallback draw at full opacity while sprite blots fade. No visible case today, because the attract round 6 has no Knot. Fix: set paint.alpha = outerAlpha in draw().

title: e2e staging runs with the rAF loop live: perf and screenshots stage before freezing the clock
detail: perf.mjs calls stage('r18-8s') and only then useManualClock, and screenshots.mjs never calls it. Real rAF frames (main.ts raf) therefore advance the run between the hook calls and before the capture, so the start state is not deterministic. That adds variance to the near-budget perf number. Also, the perf.mjs header and the architecture budget row still say 'game.frame() JS time', but the probe now times JS plus raster. Fix: call useManualClock before stage in both scripts, and update both texts.

title: Title idle: the peel happens behind the type; right two-thirds of the attract shows no action

Right of x 540 there are only a static Frog, an Owl and an empty path. Spec §10.1 Idle row: the peel sits inside the kill-pocket, right of the buttons ('type left third, play right two-thirds'). Fix: keep the narrowed wash but move the attract kill zone right. Put the attract Tern and Koi on the right loop (e.g. Tern (700,250), Koi (720,420), Frog (860,330), Owl stays (860,360)) so blots peel at x 620-960, and the ink-filled top path stays the 'threat' under the title. title: Boss arrival lands on an invisible boss: Inkmaw hidden behind the inkwell for ~4 s after bar, rumble and thud

title: Stage hooks miss their moments: r20-shed50 shows R19 clear, title-0 is ~80 ms in
detail: Now: every stage runs in a fresh page. The r20-shed50 predicate '(s.phase !== round && s.round >= 20)' is already true in the R19→R20 intermission, so the §18.6 '50% shed' capture shows 'Round 19 clear · +328' and no boss. title-0 calls toTitle() while already on title, and setScene() returns early, so sceneAt isn't reset: map alpha ≈0.2 and letters fold ~80 ms early. Acceptance-by-eye evidence is wrong for 2 rows. Fix: shed50 predicate 'b.shed50 !== undefined || s.phase === victory|defeat'. In toTitle(), force sceneAt = now. Evidence: evidence-local/screens/r20-shed50.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-tower-defense-vertical-slice/evidence/polish/title.jpg

title: Sheets ticker eases over ~450 ms and lags the cards' affordability
detail: Now: after −200 the pill reads 650→563→514→486→470→461→459→450 over about 400 ms, an ease-out tail. Spec §9 is linear at max(30, Δ·8)/s, i.e. 125 ms for Δ200. In r20-shed50 the pill shows 300 while the Tern 200 card is already greyed (the sim value is lower). title: Crackle bed can out-peak a leak (crackleMax 0.6 > leak 0.55, and 2 kHz vs 110 Hz)
detail: Now: crackleMax 0.6 is above leak 0.55. The crackle is bandpassed noise at 2 kHz, where the ear is ~15 dB more sensitive than at the leak's 110 Hz sine, so at R18 a leak can sink under the crackle even with the −8 dB alert duck. §16.19: no pop louder than a leak. Fix: crackleMax 0.3. Give the leak a 1.2 kHz bandpassed rattle body at 0.25 so it carries at R18, and assert perceived (A-weighted) leak > crackle in the unit test. Evidence: src/audio/mix.ts:52,70

title: Victory opens with a routine 'Round 20 clear · +340' banner and chime instead of 1 s of quiet
detail: Now: at victory 0-1600 ms the normal round-clear banner and bonus flight play, then cranes start. Spec: '1 s of quiet; ambient only'. Fix: skip the roundClear banner, chime and bonus flight on round 20 (fold the bonus into the card), and hold 1 s of ambient before the cranes. Also: the cranes are --fold-white on paper and nearly invisible until they cross the HUD. Give them a 1-px --crease edge and the (+3,+4) shadow. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-tower-defense-vertical-slice/evidence/polish/vic.jpg

title: Petal shadow offset is (+2,+3), not (+3,+4); game-over card has a 75-px dead band
detail: Now: the drifting-petal shadow is drawn at ellipse(2,3) (§16.15 says every shadow is (+3,+4)). On the game-over card the stats line (y 336) and the buttons (y 430) leave a 75-px empty band, and the card reads top-heavy. Fix: petal shadow at SHADOW_OFFSET. On the card, add a second stat line ('Best defender …' as on Victory) or move the buttons up to y 400 and shrink the card to 460×270. Evidence: evidence-local/screens/gameover.jpg

evidence: Raster cut: sidebar base sheet and at-rest Satchel cards blitted from a device-px cache (ui/draw.ts createBlitCache, ui/sidebar.ts), sidebar 1.04→0.29 ms; paper baked into the opaque ground cache and the paper fill skipped on unshaken play frames, ground blitted 1:1 at whole device px (ui/garden.ts, app/game.ts); grain as a device-px tile pattern. Probe: 330-frame warm-up (one lobe-phase cycle) then median of 3 restaged 300-frame passes, all passes in perf.json. Quiet box: median p95 3.8/4.0/4.2/4.6/4.9/5.8 ms across runs; worst single pass 6.7. verify:strict GREEN 28.3 s. Budget unchanged (8 ms).

Same fix as F-006 (raster cuts + median-of-3 probe). Unit flake: 165/165 across 6 consecutive runs this session; the load-sensitive failure was not reproduced on a quiet box (the 3 reviewers were running Chromium concurrently).

sim/index.ts holdInterpolation(): during hit-stop ps=s for blots, px/py=x/y for projectiles, pangle=angle for towers (none of these are hashed: determinism and parity unchanged). Test peel.test.ts 'F-007: during hit-stop every previous-tick pose equals the current one'.

app/game.ts keydown: preventDefault for Space/Backspace/Delete first (also on repeats), then all repeats dropped. Test game.test.ts 'F-008: a held Backspace/Delete (key auto-repeat) never sells' (10 repeat events each, tower survives, defaultPrevented true).

ui/garden.ts ensureOverlays: vignette stored as its two edge bands only; grain at an integer scale is an (128·res)² device tile pattern (DPR 2: 1 MB vs 31.6 MB), full canvas only at fractional scales. Rebuild only on canvas size / transform change.
render/blots.ts sprites.get: cb normalised to false for Shadow and Flash, pale to false for Flash before keying; Sprite.half removed.
render/blots.ts draw: paint.alpha = c.globalAlpha (the pass alpha), so live Knot/Inkmaw paths fade with the title→play transition exactly as sprites do.

perf.mjs: useManualClock before stage (and stage() already calls setManual itself, testhook.ts:100, so screenshots were already deterministic); header and architecture.md budget row now say 'JS + that frame's raster (1-px readback)'.
README controls: 'Esc/P pause · R R restart (in pause: press R twice within 2 s)' (matches game.ts:420).

Win script 49 seeds.
